{"triples": [{"subject": "Bi-LSTM", "predicate": "uses", "object": "morphological feature tagging tasks", "object_type": "Task", "source_sentence": "Overall Architecture We use Bi-LSTM-based taggers for the morphological feature tagging tasks."}, {"subject": "LSTM", "predicate": "uses", "object": "context", "object_type": "Concept", "source_sentence": "We use two LSTM layers to model the relevant context for both directions of the target word, where the input is represented by the vi vectors mentioned above."}, {"subject": "LSTM", "predicate": "uses", "object": "character sequence", "object_type": "Concept", "source_sentence": "We use convolutional neural networks (CNN) and LSTM-based architectures for the character embedding vectors vci, both applied to the character sequence within each word separately."}, {"subject": "LSTM", "predicate": "uses", "object": "POS tagging", "object_type": "Task", "source_sentence": "LSTM-based architectures have been shown to outperform CNN-based character embedding in POS tagging , but we experiment with both architectures to report their performance in noisy EGY content."}]}
